sn34.13:1.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo.
sn34.13:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattakusalo.
sn34.13:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo.
sn34.13:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo ca.
